Apprentice.name: Blinding Flash
Apprentice.effect:
Send a blinding flash of light at a creature. It must make a Fortitude save 
 Success: Target is dazzled for one turn.
 Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute 
 Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

Adept.name: Soul Sight
Adept.effect:
With an incantation you can see the souls of others.
While this spell is active you have the effect of Soul Sight advantage.
Adept.upcast: At Archmage: The spell does not need to be sustained

Adept.name: Beam of Light
Adept.actions: -
Adept.effect:
Casts a beam of light that can blind a multiple creatures in a 1 tile wide, 6 tiles long line. Any creatures in the line must make a Fortitude save. 
Success: Target is dazzled for one turn. 
Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute. 
Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute. 
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

Magus.name: Air Slice
Magus.effect: Send out a cutting wind, dealing 3d10 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save.
Magus.upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.description: A duelists weapon, for outmaneuvering their foes on the battlefield

selectedRunes.name: Major Striking
selectedRunes.effect: The weapon has an item bonus of +3 to hit

selectedRunes.name: Major Aura Cleaving
selectedRunes.effect: The weapon does three extra damage dice to auras

selectedRunes.name: Anti-Tampering
selectedRunes.effect: The item cannot be affected by Manipulation spells such as Ferrokinesis

actions.name: Guardians of Ages
actions.effect: The Aeonfonar creates up to 6 illusory copies of itself within 10 tiles. These copies can move and attack as usual but cannot use spells and disappear if they would take any damage. When it uses this ability the Aeonfonar can immiditaly switch places with one of the copies that it could Move to

actions.name: Mislead
actions.effect: The Aeonfonar Traverses and creates an illusary copy of itself where it stood before, as per Guardians of Ages. It may then choose to switch position with the created copy.
